title: Multithreading
body: What is the best way of using it on multiple threads on a dedicated server with a lot of cpu cores?

nodes.body: Netcode is not designed to be multithreaded like that, keep netcode on one thread, and then do all your other work on the CPU cores. If you want to generate packets to send on multiple cores, you can then copy those packets in to netcode to send on the main thread. If you want to receive packets, and farm out to multiple cores to do work, you can then take those packets received to buffers and then farm that work out to multiple cores, but the core of netcode needs to run on one thread. -- cheers
